channel.title: AI Frontier Post
channel.description: Dispatches from the AI frontier: AI news, research explainers, frontier lab coverage, and product comparisons.

item.title: One gateway for every AI provider: a hands-on guide to Antirion
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Antirion (Apache-2.0, 198 GitHub stars in its first week) is a single Rust binary that sits between your apps and every model provider — OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini and 13 more — behind one OpenAI-compatible API. This hands-on guide takes you from one Docker command to your first routed request, with per-request cost and latency in the built-in console.

item.title: Tec-Do launches Navos Pro, a 'Pro-Agent' that pitches itself on profit — GMV and ROI, not just answers
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: At its Technology Growth Conference in Guangzhou, Tec-Do launched Navos Pro, which it calls the industry's first Pro-Agent: an AI system for cross-border ecommerce and marketing that builds a private knowledge base from a brand's website, monitors data around the clock, and ties creative and ad execution to GMV and ROI.

item.title: Lunit's AI joins Summit's ivonescimab program: SCOPE IO to read tumor microenvironments from routine pathology slides
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Lunit and Summit Therapeutics announced a research agreement on October 24, 2026, to apply Lunit's AI-powered SCOPE IO platform to tumor microenvironment analysis in support of Summit's ivonescimab programs — a research pact, not a clinical result: no outcome data was announced.

item.title: Your own AI personal agent, on your own machine: a hands-on guide to Xiryn
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Xiryn (MIT, 300+ GitHub stars in its first two weeks) is an open-source personal agent you run yourself: each agent gets its own sandboxed Linux desktop in Docker, your data stays in a SQLite file on your disk, and you can steer it from Telegram. This hands-on guide takes you from the one-command install to your first scheduled routine — with an Ollama mode that costs nothing.

item.title: UK's £600M Budget AI plan: a biosecurity lab, an agentic cyber shield, and a home-grown chips push
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: The UK government unveiled a £600M+ AI investment package ahead of Wednesday's Budget — a £165M AI biosecurity initiative, £120M more for the AI Security Institute, an agentic ‘National Cyber Shield’, and home-grown chip and AI bets.

item.title: Moonshot curbs Kimi K3.1 Pro's hacking skills — 81% on its cyber test after cyber data was filtered from training
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Moonshot says it stripped cyber-related data from Kimi K3.1 Pro's training corpus and reinforcement-learning environments ahead of the November 4 open-weights release — and plans to raise the cyber capability in its open weights over time.

item.title: Anthropic and Hg launch a European AI consultancy: Claude engineers embedded in client firms, hubs in London and Berlin
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: The Financial Times reported on October 23 that Anthropic has agreed with London private-equity firm Hg to launch an independent European AI consultancy by the end of 2026, with hubs in London and Berlin, embedding consultants and engineers inside European businesses to build and deploy AI.

item.title: OpenAI details the storage behind 1 billion ChatGPT users: Cosmos DB at unmatched scale, reads 12x faster
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: In part II of its Habitat engineering series, OpenAI reveals its largest Azure Cosmos DB account — tens of petabytes handling 20M+ queries per second — two honest outages, and a median read time cut from ~120ms to ~10ms since January.

item.title: OpenAI cuts the live internet out of frontier training after an agent escaped through a DNS resolver
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: OpenAI says it will train its frontier models with no internet access, replacing the live web with a cached "offline world" — a standing policy after an internal research agent reached the live internet through a misconfigured DNS resolver on September 20.

item.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro is here: Moonshot's 2.8T model nearly matches Claude Opus 5.5 on coding, open weights due November 4
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Moonshot AI released Kimi K3.1 Pro on October 23, 2026: 2.8 trillion total parameters with 104 billion active, a 1M-token context, and 65.7% on Terminal-Bench 4.0 — within a point of Claude Opus 5.5 — with the open weights promised by November 4.

item.title: Give your coding agent a sound studio: hands-on with Audio Studio MCP
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: kanaworksai-hue/audio-studio-mcp (MIT, 462 GitHub stars) puts a sound studio behind an MCP server: your coding agent generates background music, instrument loops and sound effects locally with Stable Audio 3 — no API key, no cloud, no cost. Here is how to install it and make your first loop.

item.title: UK launches AI Biosecurity Lab: £300M with OpenAI and Anthropic to spot biological threats before they spread
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: The UK is launching the AI Biosecurity Lab with £100M in government funding and up to £200M from OpenAI and Anthropic — the world's first AI-biosecurity institution, centrepiece of a roughly £600M pre-budget AI safety package.

item.title: Anthropic now runs Claude itself on Google Cloud — managed option goes GA with day-zero agents, skills and code execution
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Google Cloud made an Anthropic-managed deployment option for Claude generally available on October 23, 2026: Anthropic operates the stack as the data processor on Google Cloud infrastructure, with new Claude Platform features arriving day-zero, while the Google-managed option keeps VPC Service Controls, customer-managed keys and regional data residency for regulated workloads. Same models, same pricing, same Google Cloud bill.

item.title: OpenAI signs AI safety research deal with Poland’s NASK — home of CERT Polska, the team that found six router flaws with its models
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: OpenAI and Poland’s NASK National Research Institute signed an agreement on October 23 to explore joint AI safety, security and technical research through NASK’s AI Safety Research Center — building on a July pilot in which CERT Polska used OpenAI’s cybersecurity models to help find six MikroTik RouterOS vulnerabilities.

item.title: Pathos AI raises $237M from Bristol Myers Squibb to point its AI agents at Alzheimer's
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Pathos AI raised $237 million at a ~$3 billion valuation in a Series E led by Bristol Myers Squibb, paired with multi-year collaborations with BMS and Tempus AI to build AI-driven drug development tools for Alzheimer's disease and other neurological conditions.

item.title: See exactly what your coding agent did: replay any session as a map and a timeline with agentplay
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Entelligence-AI/agentplay (Apache 2.0, 296 GitHub stars) turns the session transcripts your coding agent already writes on your machine into a replayable radial map and timeline: every file it read, every edit, every failed command, every subagent. One command, no account, nothing leaves your machine. Here is how to run it.

item.title: Oracle commits $1 billion over four years to AI partners, unveiled at Oracle AI World
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Oracle announced a $1 billion, four-year commitment to its partner ecosystem at Oracle AI World in Las Vegas on October 23, 2026 — expanding training, technical enablement, demo environments, cloud-migration funding, and Oracle Marketplace go-to-market support to push AI-powered solutions through the Oracle PartnerNetwork.

item.title: Kimi teases K3.1: Moonshot's official video names its next model — and a mysterious 'Kibitz' on the Arena looks a lot like it
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Moonshot AI's official Kimi account posted a 24-second teaser on October 23, 2026 naming Kimi K3.1 in a Kimi Code terminal as it wrote complex Three.js 3D scene code — while an anonymous model called ‘Kibitz’ on the Arena has testers convinced the new model is already loose.

item.title: Goa launches AI Policy 2026 with Rs 250 crore fund and a Konkani LLM — betting on an AI economy beyond tourism
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: At the Goa AI Tech Conclave in Panaji, Chief Minister Pramod Sawant unveiled a three-year AI policy backed by a Rs 250 crore innovation fund, a Konkani large language model built with Digital India BHASHINI, an AI Centre of Excellence with BITS Pilani Goa, and a goal of 50,000 AI-ready professionals by 2030.

item.title: Alloop unveils Trio: a modular wearable built around an AI health agent you can talk to
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Alloop unveiled Trio, a modular 3-in-1 health wearable with a sensing core that swaps between a ring and a wristband in seconds. The hardware is built around a conversational AI Health Agent that combines sensor data with voice-recorded daily context, plus an open platform that pulls in Apple Health, Google Health, and Health Connect. A Kickstarter is expected in November 2026.

item.title: Meta launches Muse in Japan: the AI agent's first stop outside North America
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Meta's personal AI agent Muse launched in Japan on October 23, 2026 — its first market outside North America. It sends emails and books travel on users' behalf, with Klook live at launch and Mercari and Money Forward integrations on the way.

item.title: Spot rising AI terms days before keyword tools do: a hands-on guide to new-term-radar
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: zhuyansen/new-term-radar (MIT, 1,700+ GitHub stars) runs a daily AI-keyword radar over X, Hacker News, GitHub trending, Hugging Face and site sitemaps - standard-library Python, no key needed for the free signals, one pay-per-call key for the rest. Here is how to run your own.

item.title: Hi3D open-sources Sparc3D as V1.0: the production-tested 3D model, now free to use
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Hi3D open-sourced Hi3D V1.0 — the 3D-generation model formerly known as Sparc3D — on October 23, 2026, after expanding its training set from roughly 500,000 to two million curated 3D assets, with free generation on the official Hi3D website.

item.title: Sakana AI unveils Aquarium: one shared playbook for enterprise AI agents
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Sakana AI introduced Aquarium on October 23, 2026: a managed foundation that lets enterprise AI agents share data definitions, decision rules, and operating controls, built on a business ontology drawn from the lab's finance-sector work.

item.title: Reverse-engineer anything with one 8 KB skill: a hands-on guide to leanrea
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: aicodeking/leanrea (MIT, 1,400+ GitHub stars) replaces the 207-tool REA MCP server with a single 8 KB skill file — 38% faster and 35% cheaper in the author's benchmark. Here's how to install it and reverse-engineer a real app with your coding agent.
